acceptanceCriteria: The issue's shape selects setup/scenario_a.setup.ts and only that file.
A computed access SHARED[k] in a reached file returns ALL with a typed reason.
A spec reaching no shared constant still returns selected with an empty list.
Spec requirement(s) recorded with acceptance evidence.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1082 (2026-10-18), observed on main-c976d52. Related to V1-1587 (setup-select). Shape: lib/data/shared_map.ts exports const SHARED = {scenario_a:{...}}; setup/scenario_a.setup.ts imports SHARED and seeds SHARED.scenario_a; lib/data/contexts/a_context.ts reads SHARED.scenario_a; tests/x.spec.ts imports a_context. Expected: setup/scenario_a.setup.ts selected, or ALL with a typed reason. Actual: {mode:selected, setupFiles:[], reasons:[]} so the run skips a required seed (fails open). Proposal: select a setup file reading the same literal property of the same exported constant (as the registry-key path does); a computed access fails closed with e.g. shared-constant-key-unresolved.
title: tests setup-select fails open when setup is linked only through a shared constant map key (issue #1082)
